searchText: Mainly just easy tools for doing it quickly (ie. doing an entire aggregation tree of SNARKs in like 1-4 seconds) Call in 7 minutes! Reading list from today's call: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4337 - ERC-4337 Account Abstraction Using Alt Mempool https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7562 - ERC-7562 Account Abstraction Validation Scope Rules https://github.com/ethereum/RIPs/blob/master/RIPS/rip-7560.md - RIP-7560 Native Account Abstraction https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3074 - EIP-3074 AUTH and AUTHCALL opcodes https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5003 - EIP-5003 Insert Code into EOAs with AUTHUSURP https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5806 - EIP-5806 Delegate transaction https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7377 - EIP-7377 Migration Transaction https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7949 - EIP-7553 Separated Payer Transaction One question on 7560, are the mempool rules listed in erc-7562 supposed to be required by core clients? https://github.com/ethereum/ercs/blob/master/ERCS/erc-7562.md <@703292811969036399> <@727296082484265073> in other words, what is the minimal thing core clients can do w.r.t. the mempool I synthesized my notes from the call into this document, open to feedback on things like format for future call notes going forward https://notes.ethereum.org/QT9e9r6NRdSOjWRBzA3JLA
